integrity: The recurrence, companion factorization, and explicit orbit are independently reconstructed in the proof; exact-rational identities and finite numerical spectral examples were checked by the included standalone program. Computations do not establish the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: All positive control parameters are classified for primitive period-two existence; attraction is only proved locally for a sufficiently small positive offset from the first flip. No higher-period, global attraction, infinite-history or stochastic claims. Historical priority is provisional, independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Exact period-two census and supercritical onset in a finite-memory fractional logistic map
